steps.title: Add Proteinase K to Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel P20 pipette, pick up tips, dispense 10 µL Proteinase K Solution into each user‑selected column of the Sample Plate, then discard the tips.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL Proteinase K Solution into each selected column of the Sample Plate

steps.title: Add Wash Buffer to Wash 1 Plate
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel P300 pipette, pick up tips, transfer 1000 µL Wash Buffer into each user‑selected column of the Wash 1 Plate, then discard the tips.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1000 µL Wash Buffer into each selected column of the Wash 1 Plate

steps.title: Add Ethanol to Wash 2 Plate
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel P300 pipette, pick up tips, transfer 1000 µL 80 % Ethanol into each user‑selected column of the Wash 2 Plate, then discard the tips.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1000 µL 80 % Ethanol into each selected column of the Wash 2 Plate

steps.title: Add Ethanol to Wash 3 Plate
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel P300 pipette, pick up tips, transfer 500 µL 80 % Ethanol into each user‑selected column of the Wash 3 Plate, then discard the tips.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL 80 % Ethanol into each selected column of the Wash 3 Plate

steps.title: Add Elution Solution to Elution Plate
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel P300 pipette, pick up tips, transfer 100 µL Elution Solution into each user‑selected column of the Elution Plate, then discard the tips.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL Elution Solution into each selected column of the Elution Plate
